cause: Active claim discovery followed filesystem aliases, authority fields used truthiness coercion, and work close selected its resolver key from unvalidated frontmatter instead of the canonical path.
prevention: Require direct lexical and resolved claim-store identity, presence-aware typed unit specs, exact typed frontmatter identities, and path-derived canonical close resolution before any mutation.
summary: Closure accepted redirected active claims, falsey authority fields, and metadata-derived resolver identities before mutation.
title: Bind close authority to direct canonical stores and identities
